description: Itinéraires cyclables sur le territoire de Saint-Nazaire Agglo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CARENE. Structured and marked cycle routes on the territory of Saint-Nazaire Agglomération - la CARENE (Trignac, Besné, La Chapelle-des-Marais, Donges, Montoir-de-Bretagne, Pornichet, Saint-André-des-Eaux, Saint-Joachim, Saint-Malo-de-Guersac, Saint-Nazaire). Coverage: CARENE. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle routes in the territory of Saint-Nazaire Agglo" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CARENE. Its keywords include mobilite, jalonnement, itineraire, velo, gpx, culture-tourisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2023-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
